version_note: Hilux CS4800 v2: profiles, member rules (frame, sash, mullion, glazing beads, sash glass adaptors) and deductions from the Hilux CS4800 DXF, tuned to reproduce EvA design 123 where the two differ by rounding. Hardware rules unchanged from v1 (Hilux sheet). Door rows never fire (no door typology yet). Notes with ASSUMPTION/CHECK are open in doc/hilux-questions.md.

deduction_notes.bar_end_mullion: CHECK: a bar ending on another bar; the DXF gives only the frame end, 25.5 used for every end (question Q9.3)
deduction_notes.bar_end_transom: CHECK: a bar ending on another bar; the DXF gives only the frame end, 25.5 used for every end (question Q9.3)
deduction_notes.sash_side_frame: DXF: sash W-(18.5*2) on a single-sash window; EvA 123 sash 727 / 1463
deduction_notes.sash_side_mullion: CHECK: from EvA 123 (750 - 18.5 - 4.5 = 727); the DXF has no sash-on-mullion formula (question Q9.3)
deduction_notes.sash_side_transom: CHECK: taken equal to sash_side_mullion; neither the DXF nor EvA 123 has a transom (question Q9.3)
deduction_notes.sash_glass: CHECK: EvA 123 gives 57 (727 - 2 x 57 = 613); the DXF gives HS-((52.7*2)+8), i.e. 56.7 per side. EvA kept (question Q9.3)
deduction_notes.fixed_glass_side_frame: DXF: fixed glass W-((25.5*2)+8) = 29.5 per side; EvA 123 1441 high
deduction_notes.fixed_glass_side_mullion: CHECK: from EvA 123 (750 - 29.5 - 15.5 = 705); the DXF's two-fixed-pane formula implies 16.6 per side. EvA kept (question Q9.3)
deduction_notes.fixed_glass_side_transom: CHECK: taken equal to fixed_glass_side_mullion; neither the DXF nor EvA 123 has a transom (question Q9.3)
deduction_notes.glazing_gasket: CHECK: kept from v1 (14) for the CS4800 glazing gasket rules; EvA 123 cuts G23 at glass - 32 on the fixed pane and glass - 26 on the sash pane, which one deduction cannot give (question Q9.3)
